excerpt.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂慷慨回应。生命之织缕将[From.GetName]转变成了一颗盖亚星球，使其成为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的一片理想家园。
excerpt.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The Composer of Strands has transformed [From.GetName] into a Gaia World, making it an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind.
